---

### Read miRNA data
```{r}
microRNA_data = t(read.csv(params$miRNAseq_mature_data_batchadjusted, row.names = 1))
microRNA_data = data.frame(microRNA_data)
```


## Read csv file containing estimated cell type proportions
```{r}
#estimated_cell_proportions <- read.csv('Z:/omics/mRNAseq_FIMM/estimated_cell_proportions.csv', row.names = 1)
estimated_cell_proportions <- readRDS('Z:/omics/EM-seq_UU/analysis/scripts/cell_type_composition.RDS')

# Remove erythrocyte column
estimated_cell_proportions <- data.frame(estimated_cell_proportions[, 2:15])

# Subset celltype proportion dataframe on Sample names
estimated_cell_proportions <- estimated_cell_proportions[colnames(microRNA_data),]
```


## Fill missing values with median of each column
```{r}
estimated_cell_proportions_imputed <- missMethods::impute_median(estimated_cell_proportions)

# Add names of samples
rownames(estimated_cell_proportions_imputed) <- colnames(microRNA_data)
estimated_cell_proportions <- estimated_cell_proportions_imputed
```



## Correct microRNA-seq data for the estimated cell type proportions
```{r}
microrna_seq_correct <- resid(lm(t(microRNA_data) ~  estimated_cell_proportions$Blood.T.CD3 +
                                        estimated_cell_proportions$Blood.T.CD4 +
                                        estimated_cell_proportions$Blood.T.CD8 +
                                        estimated_cell_proportions$Blood.T.CenMem.CD4 +
                                        estimated_cell_proportions$Blood.T.Eff.CD8 +
                                        estimated_cell_proportions$Blood.T.EffMem.CD8 +
                                        estimated_cell_proportions$Blood.T.Naive.CD4 +
                                        estimated_cell_proportions$Blood.T.Naive.CD8 +
                                        estimated_cell_proportions$Blood.NK +
                                        estimated_cell_proportions$Blood.Monocytes +
                                        estimated_cell_proportions$Blood.Granulocytes +
                                        estimated_cell_proportions$Blood.B +
                                        estimated_cell_proportions$Blood.B.Mem))

microrna_seq_correct <- t(data.frame(microrna_seq_correct))
```

## Plot differences
```{r}
library(ggplot2)
library(reshape2)
microRNA_melted <- melt(microRNA_data)
colnames(microRNA_melted) <-c('Sample_ID', 'Normalized_cpm_count')
ggplot(microRNA_melted) +
  geom_boxplot(aes(x=Sample_ID, y=Normalized_cpm_count)) +
  theme(axis.text.x=element_blank()) +
  ggtitle('Un-adjusted for cell-types')

corrected_melted <- melt(microrna_seq_correct)
colnames(corrected_melted) <-c('Transcript', 'Sample_ID', 'Normalized_cpm_count')
ggplot(corrected_melted) +
  geom_boxplot(aes(x=Sample_ID, y=Normalized_cpm_count)) +
  theme(axis.text.x=element_blank()) +
  ggtitle('Adjusted for cell-types')
```


## Save corrected data to CSV
```{r}
write.csv(microrna_seq_correct, file='Z:/omics/microRNAseq_FIMM/miRBase_mature/mature_Log_Combat_CovSex_corrected.csv')
```
